resources.string: Updates a repeater over LoRa through your companion. Turn the companion on and find it.
Choose a repeater. It has to be next to you: updates only go with no hop.
The companion has no repeaters in its contacts.
Not found in the releases. Choose the same .bin file the repeater runs.
The update runs on another frequency so the network does not stop. Default 869.470 MHz, BW 125, below the 869.618 MHz main channel. 869.40–869.65 MHz allows 10% time on air.
Delta: %1$.1f KB (new firmware %2$.0f KB), about %3$.0f min
The repeater restarts with the new firmware. After half a minute, check which firmware runs.
Stopped. The repeater keeps its old firmware.

Not logged in as admin. Check the password.
